fieldValues.title: The owner's desk is reachable only from loopback and the owner's private ZeroTier network
fieldValues.decision_question: Who may reach the control room and clerk serve, given that both act with the owner's authority?
fieldValues.context: Proposed from /ship clerk#96, from the owner's choices on 2026-10-20: the desk runs on the main desktop and is viewed from another machine's browser over ZeroTier. It is published as control.semanticops.com through the desktop's Caddy, which drops any source outside ZeroTier or loopback. The service signs commits and uses the owner's GitHub token.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: The plain LAN with bearer tokens. The LAN with TLS and tokens. A hosted service acting as a bot identity. Do nothing: the dev server on localhost only.
fieldValues.decision_statement: clerk serve binds to loopback only. The control room is published only to loopback and the owner's private ZeroTier network, and requests from other sources are dropped. Membership of that network, which the owner authorises, is the access control. Scoped tokens (read, act) come when a second client runs its own app.
fieldValues.rationale: Reaching the desk is reaching the owner's authority. ZeroTier encrypts and admits only authorised members; tokens would add machinery while there is one client.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a second machine or client needs its own app, when a device that is not the owner's joins the ZeroTier network, or when a hop leaves the overlay.
fieldValues.next_steps: clerk#97 binds clerk serve to loopback and tests the refusals.
